builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Swain: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (1,023 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 53.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A sustained close-range mage who gains health from soul collection and keeps R active by draining champions. Roots and pulls create the proximity needed for repeated Q bolts and drain. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Zhonya's Hourglass. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Spirit Visage.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 53.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Liandry's Torment → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Swain frees the demon, which deals [15 / 25 / 35 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and drains [15 / 30 / 45 + (0.05) × AP + (0.015) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After [2] seconds and every [8] seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and Slows enemies by [50]%, decaying over [1.5]s.

Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage plus [(60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP) × (0.25)] magic damage per bolt past the first (max [(60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP) × (2)] magic damage).

Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal [90 / 130 / 170 / 210 / 250 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage and Root enemies in the area for [1.5] seconds.

Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.

Swain collects Soul Fragments from Vision of Empire, Nevermove, and enemy champion deaths. Soul Fragments restore [characterLevelInterpolation(0.06 → 0.06; raw flags preserved)] maximum Health and permanently grant Swain [15] max Health.

Soul Fragments collected: @f1@
Total Health gained: [(15) × BuffStacks({0dc6979e})]

Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals [70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [50]% for [1.5] seconds.

Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for [6] seconds.

builds.name: Demon attack sustain
builds.summary: Test demon attack sustain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test demon attack sustain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Demonic Ascension drains while Swain remains near champions and allows repeated Demonflare casts after two seconds then every eight seconds. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test weaving attacks between Q/E, while Riftmaker and Visage support the drain and Bloodletter improves magic kit packets.
testPlan: Required state: Maintain nearby champions and collect a realistic recorded soul count.
Compare attacks, drain healing and Demonflare count in twelve seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack exposure or disengage depletes Demonic Energy.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R duration is sustained by enemy contact, not automatically infinite after activation.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Swain: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A sustained close-range mage who gains health from soul collection and keeps R active by draining champions. Roots and pulls create the proximity needed for repeated Q bolts and drain. Fix soul health and actual R drain contact. Tank AP must still maintain mana and threat; do not assign permanent infinite R if enemies leave drain range. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Swain: Fix soul health and actual R drain contact. Tank AP must still maintain mana and threat; do not assign permanent infinite R if enemies leave drain range.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
The route fails Swain's stated kit question: Fix soul health and actual R drain contact. Tank AP must still maintain mana and threat; do not assign permanent infinite R if enemies leave drain range.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Soul health aura siege
builds.summary: Test soul health aura siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test soul health aura siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Ravenous Flock grants 15 permanent health per actual soul; Heartsteel adds separately earned health while Visage supports soul heals and R drain. Liandry and close-range Abyssal supply magic pressure; Rylai tests keeping enemies inside the drain so energy does not expire.
testPlan: Required state: Farm actual E/W souls and reach occasional safe Heartsteel attacks.
Record soul count, Heartsteel stacks and R uptime against moving enemies.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Percent-health damage and ranged disengage erase the health advantage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Soul count cannot be invented and healing source Stat(12) does not prove every scaling term.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Heartsteel, Liandry's Torment, Abyssal Mask, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
